diagnosis.key_finding: NativeProgramType::schema_key recomputes canonical schema bytes and SHA-256. Schema hashing appears beneath actual numeric_binary_helper in optimization-only profiles; source plans are immutable and already bound to the canonical schema table.
diagnosis.next_action: Cache native type schema keys at source/image construction. Keep derived identity private and reconstruct it from actual schemas, preserve wire format/admission/ABI/fees. Qualify and run one optimization-only prospective probe before considering formal evaluation.
diagnosis.limitations: Sampling is coarse and incomplete inline stacks cannot establish exact allocation counts. No native instruction change or speedup is claimed. No profiler timings enter performance scores.

prospective_selection_policy.scope: General immutable native type schema-key caching, selected only from accepted31 optimization profiles of mvt and bicg. No holdout profiling or case selection.

training_probe.select_if: Raw geometric-mean speedup > 1.0; retain all samples, cases and regressions; no retries or exclusions.

prospective_selection_policy.formal_gate: Commit and freeze source and driver before BOTH full sets; five samples per actor/mode, original-baseline replay, strict improvement of BOTH geometric-mean Mech/C kernel scores over accepted31.
